nodes.label: Isolated URL Parser Testing
nodes.rationale: The URL parser test executable links only Qt Core, allowing fast tests without a GUI or browser window.

nodes.label: Blocking I/O Can Freeze the GUI
nodes.norm_label: blocking i/o can freeze the gui
nodes.rationale: Blocking network calls stall the Qt event loop and make the browser interface unresponsive.

nodes.label: Browser Network Layering
nodes.rationale: Establish TCP first, perform the TLS handshake over it second, and send HTTP over the resulting secure connection third.

nodes.label: Partial Socket I/O
nodes.rationale: Socket send and receive operations may transfer only part of the requested data, so implementations must loop.

nodes.label: RAII Socket Ownership
nodes.rationale: Own the socket file descriptor in a class and close it in the destructor to tie resource lifetime to object lifetime.

nodes.label: Graphify Path
nodes.rationale: Use a shortest-path query to explore relationships between two concepts.

nodes.label: Graphify Query
nodes.rationale: Use the existing knowledge graph to answer natural-language questions about the codebase rather than scanning files.
